questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Bash?
questions.explanation: In Bash, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: What MUST every recursive function have?
options: A base case that stops the recursion
questions.correctAnswer: A base case that stops the recursion
questions.explanation: Without a base case, recursion never ends.
